item.title: Iranian president, FM reemerge in public despite Netanyahu’s threatened '10 plagues' of war
item.description: Senior Iranian leaders appeared at pro-regime rallies in Tehran after weeks out of public view, signaling defiance despite Israeli claims of targeting top officials; Araghchi: 'There are no negotiations, there is an exchange of messages. We will not accept a ceasefire'

item.title: Israel pushes US to hit Iran energy sites, says it could collapse regime
item.description: Officials in Jerusalem said a target bank focused on energy facilities and critical infrastructure has already been prepared, with any potential strike now dependent on a decision by Trump

item.title: Netanyahu: Iran no longer poses an existential threat to Israel
item.description: PM claims Iran had invested nearly $1 trillion in its military buildup, including nuclear and missile programs, and now he says that investment has now been 'wasted'

item.title: Israel says air campaign cripples much of Iran’s defense industry
item.description: Security officials say Israeli Air Force nearing completion of attacks on Iran’s most vital military-industrial sites, while citing close coordination with US as campaign expands and more targets are prepared for weeks ahead

item.title: Netanyahu: Israel over halfway to war goals in Iran, no timeline for ending conflict
item.description: PM says Israel and the US have struck Iran’s missile systems, weapons factories and nuclear personnel, while warning Tehran’s growing missile range could soon threaten Europe and beyond

item.title: 'We go with Trump': Israel says it will accept any US call on next phase of Iran war
item.description: Senior Israeli official says Jerusalem has told Washington it will go along with whatever Trump decides, unlike last June when Israel objected to ending the fighting and the US president ordered Israeli warplanes to turn back

item.title: כך מתדלקת המלחמה באיראן את השוק השחור של תרופות המרשם בישראל
item.description: אופיואידים ממכרים, גלולות קשב וריכוז, זריקות הרזיה - וגם תרופות שינה והרגעה. השוק השחור של תרופות המרשם בישראל, דרך ערוצי הטלגרם, היה עוד קודם רווי פעילות. ואז באה המלחמה הנוכחית - והחמירה עוד יותר את המצב. "7 ימים" שוחח עם סוחרים שהבטיחו "פנטה אורגינל", וגם עם מומחים וחוקרים,...

item.title: Israel spotted Radwan buildup before Hezbollah strike, weighed preemptive attack
item.description: Security officials say Israel detected about 1,000 Radwan Force operatives mobilizing in southern Lebanon before Hezbollah’s opening retaliation to Iran war, prompting discussions of possible preemptive strike

item.title: Iran missile fire sets off 3rd round of sirens in central Israel since morning
item.description: One missile intercepted en route to center, another falls in open area in West Bank; at least 10 people lightly wounded in previous salvos after cluster missile attack
